notes.title: The return of the Kung - Patch 1.4.4
notes.content:
Welcome back Kung Fury, we have been expecting you...

March 15th marks the date when Kung Fury returns to Steam in full force. Ultimate Edition contains the original content previously exclusive to the DLCs. The game will be coming to our friends on Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo and Stove over the next couple of days so let's get together, stop Kung Führer and uphold the law!

notes.title: Ultimate Edition = True
notes.content:
Hello There, dear community members. We are making a few changes to the Kung Fury game for the upcoming console release to have a more coherent gaming experience. 

When we released the long-awaited update "A day at the Beach" in November year 2021, it was in the form of a DLC. When we make the move to a new console, we would like to deliver one complete, Ultimate product without the need for DLCs. Steam users have expressed a fair bit of concern about needing the base game when they want to play David Hasselhoff in the new coop game campaign. So with all that in mind, we will be taking down the game from Steam to rebrand it and change things around to remove the need of DLCs for players to enjoy Kung Fury. Existing customers will retain access to everything, and we humbly thank you for being with us from the start, playing the DLCs and giving us valuable feedback on how to improve the game.

When the game returns later this year, it will be in its Ultimate form. We hope that you stick around and celebrate the return with us.

Have a great summer ❤

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8895947/b44c15393428114cc1a5ab8fdf9a072f9b90f088.png[/img]

notes.title: Public Test Build!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

If those of you who have experienced problems with the left attack button and black starting screen could help us with some testing, we would really appreciate it! 

We have a test build containing; 
- Potential fix to the problem where the screen is black when you get past the intro (this is the same issue as having a diamond in the middle of the screen) 
- Shutting off peripheral support to see if it resolves the "Left Attack" problem.

We are having a hard time reproducing the left attack bug so we want to see if this helps or narrows down the issue. 

Please opt in to this testbuild by: 
1. Right click Kung Fury: Street Rage in your library. 
2. Select properties 
3. Select Betas 
4. Select publictestbuild 
5. A Steam restart might be needed to download the patch. 
6. Please reply [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/373180/discussions/0/618463446161913699/] here [/url] and let us know what issue you had and if the problem is fixed or still present. 

Many thanks for your help!

notes.title: Thanks for your feedback!
notes.content:
Wow, thanks for all your amazing feedback!! 

We're reading the forum and reviews, and are taking in all your comments and wishes! For now, we're prioritising fixing the bugs though, to make sure you can all enjoy the game! 

We'll start with looking into the left button bug for those of you who have had issues with the controls, and look into why the game only renders the arcade machine and not the rest of the game for some people.

We might contact some of you who have reported issues, to ask you more about them! 

Cheers,
The Hello There dev team
